commands.name: Get UMS Status
commands.description: Returns UMS server status and version information.

commands.name: Get Firmware
commands.description: Lists all firmware versions registered in UMS.

commands.name: Get Devices
commands.description: Lists all devices. Use Filter=details for extended info.

commands.name: Get Profiles
commands.description: Lists all profiles registered in UMS.

commands.name: Restart Device
commands.description: Restarts a device by ID. Requires confirmation.

commands.name: Update Device Firmware
commands.description: Assigns a new firmware version to a device. Requires confirmation.

commands.name: Move Device
commands.description: Moves a device to a different directory. Requires confirmation.
